Aksha - Intelligent surveillance system is envisioned to automatically monitor the environment or premises with less or without human intervention.
Such monitoring tasks include automatically detecting objects, unusual situations and performing further analysis and actions.
Computer vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Gen AI play a very important role in developing such intelligent systems.

Aksha on multi edge: Mapping between edge devices and cameras

The feed of all the cameras will be visible on the same GUI, whereas each camera will be running on a different hardware device, i.e. raspberry pi
All the cameras run on the same network.
Every camera communicates with the backend, which runs on the Azure app service. The feed is then sent to the front-end from the back-end
Enhancing Aksha’s Scalability: Using Kubernetes and Kafka
Enhancing Aksha’s Scalability: Architecture and Advantages

Effortless Scalability: Easily scale microservices with Kubernetes and manage high message volumes with Kafka.

Decoupled Architecture: Allows independent service development and deployment, improving fault tolerance and maintainability.

Real-time Data Processing: Facilitates real-time data streaming for timely insights and actions.

High Availability: Maintains reliable performance through Kubernetes orchestration and Kafka’s distributed messaging.
